newsitem.title: USA: Corrections Corp gets prison contract.
newsitem.headline: Corrections Corp gets prison contract.

text.p: Corrections Corp of America said Tuesday it had received a contract to house 1,500 inmates from the District of Columbia in a prison the company is building in Youngstown, Ohio.

The company said the contract would generate more than $30 million in revenues annually. The first 1,000 prison beds are to be available February 19, and the remaining 500 are to be available on April 1, it said.
Corrections Corp designed and will own the $45 million medium-security prison.
The company builds and manages prisons and other correctional institutions for government agencies.
